holdings.name: HDFC Bank Ltd

what_changed.text: Sashidhar Jagdishan stepped down on October 26, 2026, and Anup Bagchi took charge as Managing Director and CEO on October 27, 2026.
Sanjay D’Souza superannuated on October 31, 2026, ceasing to serve as Group Head of Business Banking.
Revenue for the quarter ended September 2026 rose to Rs 95,132 crore with net profit reaching Rs 21,537 crore.

holdings.why_it_matters: HDFC Bank is the fund's largest position at 5.05% weight. Its -7.4% 3-month return generated a -0.374% contribution drag, making it the fund's top negative contributor in a 29.4% Financials allocation.

watch.text: Management execution and strategic direction under new MD and CEO Anup Bagchi.

holdings.name: ICICI Bank Ltd

what_changed.text: Net profit for the September 2026 quarter reached Rs 17,389 crore on revenue of Rs 55,992 crore, with reported H1 PAT up 20.1% year-on-year to Rs 14,843 crore.
Credit rating agencies ICRA and CARE reaffirmed the bank's ratings on October 23, 2026.
A Telangana GST appellate order confirmed a Rs 6,95,418 penalty, which the bank disclosed it will appeal.
The bank revised fixed deposit interest rates for general and senior citizen depositors.

holdings.why_it_matters: At 3.55% weight, ICICI Bank is the fund's second-largest holding. Its -2.61% 3-month return helped curb losses relative to HDFC Bank while retaining heavy exposure to large-cap lenders.

watch.text: Proceedings and outcome regarding the appeal against the Telangana GST appellate penalty order.

holdings.name: Jyoti CNC Automation Ltd.

what_changed.text: Crisil assigned A+/Stable and A1 ratings to Rs 1,415 crore of bank facilities on October 17, 2026.
For the quarter ended June 2026, the company posted sales of Rs 508 crore and net profit of Rs 57 crore.

holdings.why_it_matters: Holding a 2.51% weight, the stock gained 11.99% over 3 months, generating an estimated +0.301% contribution and serving as the primary performer in the fund's 14.8% Industrials bucket.

watch.text: Board meeting and conference call scheduled for November 3, 2026 to review Q2 and H1 FY27 results.

holdings.name: Divi's Laboratories Ltd

what_changed.text: Net profit for the June 2026 quarter grew to Rs 902 crore on sales of Rs 3,080 crore, with operating profit margin expanding to 41%.
Shares gained after a weight loss drug received backing from a European Union panel.

holdings.why_it_matters: With a 2.2% weight, the stock surged 21.4% over 3 months to deliver the fund's largest positive contribution (+0.471%), anchoring the 10.4% Healthcare exposure.

watch.text: Board meeting on November 7, 2026 to approve unaudited financial results for Q2 and H1 FY27.

holdings.name: Axis Bank Ltd

what_changed.text: SEBI issued a final order imposing regulatory censure on subsidiary Axis Capital Limited on October 28, 2026.
Independent Director Girish Paranjpe ceased to be on the board effective November 1, 2026.
For the quarter ended September 2026, the bank reported revenue of Rs 38,087 crore and net profit of Rs 7,666 crore.
The bank announced revisions to savings account transaction limits and charges effective December 1, 2026.

holdings.why_it_matters: Axis Bank forms 2.11% of the fund, adding to an aggregated 10.71% concentration across the fund's top three private banking positions.

watch.text: Customer and deposit response to revised savings account transaction charges taking effect December 1, 2026.

holdings.name: Zomato Ltd

what_changed.text: The company announced the launch of a Mehmaan Mode feature designed for group food ordering.
Policy updates indicated gig workers across platforms will be covered under a new social security board offering pension and insurance benefits.

holdings.why_it_matters: Representing 2.05% of the portfolio, the stock rose 13.62% over 3 months, supporting the performance of the fund's 11.8% Technology allocation.

watch.text: Regulatory details and cost impact stemming from the implementation of the new social security board for gig workers.

holdings.name: Interglobe Aviation Ltd

what_changed.text: IndiGo posted a net loss of Rs 1,879 crore (INR 18.8 billion) for Q2 FY27, while revenue rose 26% year-on-year to Rs 23,364 crore.

holdings.why_it_matters: Holding a 2.03% weight, the stock declined -5.67% over 3 months, dampening returns across the fund's 14.8% Industrials sleeve.

watch.text: Cost dynamics and route profitability following the reported second-quarter loss of Rs 1,879 crore.

holdings.name: Kotak Mahindra Bank Ltd

what_changed.text: Anup Kumar Saha was appointed MD and CEO effective January 1, 2027.
Net profit for the September 2026 quarter reached Rs 5,645 crore on revenue of Rs 19,856 crore.
Anu Aggarwal was appointed as Senior Management Personnel on October 24, 2026.

holdings.why_it_matters: At a 1.96% weight, the stock rallied 18.27% over 3 months, generating an estimated +0.358% contribution that counterbalanced weakness in HDFC Bank.

watch.text: Operational handover ahead of Anup Kumar Saha assuming the MD and CEO role on January 1, 2027.

holdings.name: Multi Commodity Exchange Of India Ltd

what_changed.text: MCX incorporated a wholly owned subsidiary named MCX Mineral Exchange of India Limited on October 16, 2026.
Key managerial personnel roles were reassigned, placing Rashmi Nihalani over Strategy and Training and Chittaranjan Rege over Strategic Corporates and Research.
In the June 2026 quarter, revenue stood at Rs 702 crore with net profit of Rs 413 crore.

holdings.why_it_matters: Holding a 1.92% weight, MCX delivered an 18.45% 3-month return, adding +0.354% to fund performance and bolstering financial market infrastructure exposure.

watch.text: Board meeting on November 3, 2026 to approve Q2 and H1 FY26-27 unaudited financial results.

holdings.name: Mrs. Bectors Food Specialities Ltd

what_changed.text: For the quarter ended June 2026, revenue was Rs 549 crore and net profit was Rs 39 crore.
Shareholders approved FY26 financial results, dividend, and director reappointments at the AGM held on September 18, 2026.

holdings.why_it_matters: At 1.88% weight, the stock declined -12.05% over 3 months, acting as a drag within the fund's 3.0% Consumer Staples allocation.

watch.text: Board meeting scheduled for November 4, 2026 to approve Q2 and H1 FY27 financial results.

portfolio.statement: Invesco India ELSS Tax Saver Fund maintains 98.3% equity exposure, oriented primarily toward Financials (29.4%), Consumer Discretionary (16.6%), and Industrials (14.8%).
interp: Top private banks exhibited sharp return dispersion, with Kotak Mahindra Bank advancing 18.27% over 3 months while HDFC Bank dropped -7.4% amid executive transitions.
Specialised mid- and large-cap holdings in healthcare, software, and exchanges cushioned the portfolio against drag from aviation and select lending assets.
portfolio.line: Leadership changes and profitability divergence across top private lenders shaped fund performance alongside strong gains in healthcare and market infrastructure.

drivers.text: HDFC Bank fell -7.4% over 3 months amid leadership transition as Anup Bagchi took charge following Sashidhar Jagdishan's exit.
Kotak Mahindra Bank gained 18.27% over 3 months following Q2 FY27 net profit of Rs 5,645 crore and management appointments.
Divi's Laboratories contributed +0.471% over 3 months following Q1 FY27 margin expansion and EU backing for a weight loss drug.
InterGlobe Aviation posted a Q2 FY27 net loss of Rs 1,879 crore, contributing to a -5.67% 3-month return.
